verdict.rationale: Stripe supports some bulk-style operations relevant to AI agents — bulk product catalog import via the v2 Product Catalog Import API (CSV up to 4GB, upsert/replace modes), List CheckoutSessions for bulk fulfillment, and MCP/analytics tools that can query/report across many objects (stripe_analytics, stripe_report) — but there is no documented generic bulk-write or batch-update API (e.g., bulk refunds, bulk subscription updates, bulk customer edits) that an AI agent could invoke across many arbitrary items at once; most single-object write tools (stripe_api_write, Refunds API, etc.) operate one record at a time with idempotency keys rather than true batch semantics. missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch API for core objects (customers, charges, subscriptions, refunds) beyond catalog import, evidence of MCP or CLI tools performing multi-item operations in one call, and independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk operation reliability.
